Sandbox_HaloDrop_PlaneSpeed_tooltip: Players on board move at this speed too. Capped at 19 because of the anti-cheat speed check (20 tiles/s outside vehicles).
Sandbox_HaloDrop_PathLength_tooltip: Straight-line distance from point A to point B.
Sandbox_HaloDrop_PlaneZ_tooltip: The real floor the plane vehicle flies at. Default 15, same as the PongDu plane. Each floor draws 6 tiles higher on screen, so higher values shrink the stretch where the plane is visible.
Sandbox_HaloDrop_CarryZ_tooltip: The real floor a character stays on while on board and in free fall. Higher values push the visible ground away from the screen centre, into unloaded areas.
Sandbox_HaloDrop_JumpAltitude_tooltip: Virtual altitude at the jump. Sets how long the free fall lasts.
Sandbox_HaloDrop_FreefallSpeed_tooltip: Descent speed without a parachute. Hitting the ground at this speed causes heavy injury.
Sandbox_HaloDrop_CanopySpeed_tooltip: Descent speed under the parachute. Slows down automatically just before landing.
Sandbox_HaloDrop_FreefallSteer_tooltip: Horizontal speed with the movement keys during free fall.
Sandbox_HaloDrop_CanopySteer_tooltip: Horizontal speed with the movement keys under the parachute.
Sandbox_HaloDrop_AutoOpenAltitude_toolti: The parachute opens by itself at this altitude during free fall. 0 disables it.
Sandbox_HaloDrop_HideCarried_tooltip: Hides other players while they are inside the plane.
Sandbox_HaloDrop_ZoneX1_tooltip: West edge of the boarding zone, in world tile coordinates (inclusive). The zone is used only when X2 > X1 and Y2 > Y1. Leave all four at 0 to board every player.
Sandbox_HaloDrop_ZoneY1_tooltip: North edge of the boarding zone, in world tile coordinates (inclusive).
Sandbox_HaloDrop_ZoneX2_tooltip: East edge of the boarding zone, in world tile coordinates (inclusive).
Sandbox_HaloDrop_ZoneY2_tooltip: South edge of the boarding zone, in world tile coordinates (inclusive). Floor (height) is not checked.
